title: NewsClaimGroundingPayload
description: Structured assessment of whether an evidence excerpt and source context logically entail a cited claim.

verdict.description: Assessment verdict: supported if the claim is logically entailed by the excerpt and source context; unsupported if contradicted, invented, or misattributed; indeterminate if ambiguous, truncated, or unresolvable.

reason.description: Concise explanation of the verdict referencing evidence specifics.
